panels.description: Civic hall: Keel, Halyard and Oasis representatives occupy separate stations around a central table. Use indistinct background figures; keep upper hall clear.
The Measure, Maker's Seal and Covenant circle rest on the central table beneath a waiting display. Keep upper table clear.
The display offers designated human authority while the three safeguards remain inert. Keep upper display clear.
Mera faces Alex across the table while Tomas, Ada and Leona remain visible as separate witnesses. Keep upper hall clear.

items.text:
THREE SAFEGUARDS PRESENT.
AWAITING DESIGNATED HUMAN AUTHORITY.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: Take the position. You can fix Keel today.
